problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 7 & 1 & -9 & 4 \\ 6 & -3 & 9 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{3}:=-\frac{1}{3}{R}_{3}$ on $A?$

feedback.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M,$ given by

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 5 & -1 & 2 & 1 \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}$ on $M?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $-1$ times the third row to the second row.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 5 & -1 & 2 & 1 \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 5+(-1)(5) & -1+(-1)(2) & 2+(-1)(-1) & 1+(-1)(1) \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 0 & -3 & 3 & 0 \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
